seo_title: Spanish Natural Red Khaprail Roof Tiles
meta_description: Spanish khaprail tiles in natural red clay: a curved barrel profile for villas, farmhouses and restoration roofs. Made in Lahore, free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These Spanish khaprail tiles are curved, barrel-style roof tiles in natural red fired clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore for villas, farmhouses and restoration work that want a Mediterranean roof.

## How they look
The Spanish profile rises and falls in a deep curve, so a finished roof shows strong waves of light and shadow. The red colour comes from the fired clay itself, not a paint or coating, and tends to weather to a softer tone over the years. It is a bolder look than flat or French tiles and is often chosen for houses with arches, verandas and white walls.

## Where they work
- **Villa and farmhouse roofs** in a Spanish or Mediterranean style.
- **Restoration of older tiled roofs** where a curved red clay profile is wanted.
- **Gazebos, porches and boundary wall tops**.

Spanish clay roof tiles are designed to carry rain down their channels, and clay is a traditional roofing material in hot climates because a ventilated tile roof helps keep direct sun off the slab.

## Good to know
- Material: natural red fired clay (unglazed)
- Profile: Spanish (curved, barrel-like)
- Category: khaprail roof tiles
- Size, coverage per square foot and ridge pieces: confirm on enquiry

Barrel roof tiles need the right pitch, battens and fixing; have your roofer confirm these, and read [how khaprail tiles are installed](/blog/how-khaprail-roof-tiles-are-installed-slope-battens-and-overlap). To work out quantity, see [how many khaprail tiles your roof needs](/blog/how-to-calculate-how-many-khaprail-tiles-your-roof-needs).

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the curve and colour in hand, then send your roof area and city for a dated quote. Compare the [French natural red khaprail tile](/products/french-natural-red-khaprail-tiles) or browse all [khaprail tiles](/categories/khaprail-tiles).
ai_summary: Pak Clay's Spanish natural red khaprail tile is an unglazed fired clay roof tile with a curved, barrel-like Spanish profile, made in Lahore. It suits villas, farmhouses and restoration roofs, with free samples on WhatsApp and showrooms in Lahore and Islamabad.

faqs.q: What is the price of Spanish khaprail tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the roof area, ridge pieces, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Do Spanish khaprail tiles need repainting?
faqs.a: No. The red colour is the fired clay itself, so it does not need paint. Natural clay tends to weather and mellow slowly, and occasional cleaning keeps moss and dust off the channels.

faqs.q: Spanish or flat khaprail: which suits my roof?
faqs.a: Spanish tiles give deep waves and a Mediterranean look; flat tiles give a smoother, more modern surface and generally need a steeper pitch. Your roof design and slope decide, so ask your roofer and compare samples.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Spanish Natural Red Khaprail" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
